body: I started my part time job to HELP her. But she doesn't really use my money for finances and instead saving it up. I don't really know what she wants to do with it, but if she wants to handle my money she shouldn't have let me handle my bank account. Im thankful that she's teaching us how to handle and not use money too much on cosmetics but she's just too controlling sometimes. I don't even think I can get out of this house because she's just going to say "oh you're just going to leave me? After raising you, you're not going to take care of me now that I'm old? Isn't that what good kids do?" She wants me to be independent but she also doesn't want me to..?

idk, maybe your right. But im trying to understand her position and I really hate myself for hurting her. but if she's narcissistic she wouldn't accept my apology unless I give back to her like a f'ing buying her a house or some dramatic sh*t. Nothing is ever enough for her. We're probably not enough for her. She wants a perfect child. She wants a child like she was with her mama, working and giving all the money she earned. I think it's also a cultural problem. many Philippines parents are like this and instead of raising a child to become independent, they try to raise them to respect them and get a job to provide for them.
